description_en: Queries the tags that are added to resources in a template or stack in an Alibaba Cloud region
description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下查询模板或资源栈中一个或多个资源已经绑定的标签
kebab_example: aliyun ros list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type stack --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the tag. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 标签所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

stack: stack

stackgroup: stack group

template: template

templatescratch: scenario
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值：

stack：资源栈。  

stackgroup：资源栈组。

template：模板。

templatescratch：资源场景
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.
The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持指定20个标签键。如果指定该值，则不允许为空字符串。  
长度不超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.
The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag value cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持指定20个标签值。如果指定该值，可以为空字符串。  
长度不超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the resources. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 资源的标签。最多支持指定20个标签。
parameters.name: tag

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results

TagResources.description_en: The information about the tags that are added to the resources

items.description_en: The information about the tag that is added to the resource

TagKey.description_en: The tag key of the resource

TagValue.description_en: The tag value of the resource
